tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "05AC81724B6CCFAB572E6B82E9A51E18", "As Mayor, you have the authority to declare War against other Settlements in the world.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "6748C45E4FD514920C3717860F2289C7", "Before you can declare a War, you must first acquire a War Declaration Scroll. War Declaration Scrolls may be acquired by fulfilling the War Preparations Mayoral Commission.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "BE162F694FCE772EF9512196AF6EC42D", "Once your Settlement has a War Declaration Scroll, you can use it by going to the Diplomacy tab of the Citizenship Menu. Use the Declare War option after selecting target Settlement.")
